reason: Unified memory index slice S4 (design/unified-memory/60-build-step-3.md): an operator command, `nora memory rebuild` (with `--dry-run`), re-projects every store into the memory index and is also its first backfill; the nora process drains the projection queue every `[memory_index] drain_seconds`; a live delete now removes only the edges a node owns, so live projection and a rebuild agree. The index is still dark (read by nothing until S5), so no user-visible behaviour changes.
